attr.title: Yuppie Psycho: Executive Edition
attr.desc: Brian Pasternack is a young man with no future in a dystopian 90s society. His life is about to change on his first day at Sintracorp, one of the largest companies in the world. It's a strange, unsettling place, and Brian is hired for an unexpected task: to hunt the witch that haunts the building.
attr.inst: Requires Yuppie Psycho v2.5 or newer (the MonoGame engine). Copy the complete game folder from Steam (Linux build preferred, Windows build also works) into yuppiepsycho/gamedata. The first launch converts the files for ARM, which takes a minute or two.
attr.inst_md:
- Requires **Yuppie Psycho v2.5 or newer** (the MonoGame engine).
- Copy the **complete** game folder from Steam (Linux build preferred, Windows build also works) into `yuppiepsycho/gamedata`.
- The first launch converts the files for ARM, which takes a minute or two.
